answer: Concretely, the economy can lock a compute bond for six epochs and slash it the moment two answers fingerprint-match. Near-duplicate embeddings collapse the farm into one cluster. Because it works by pricing registration in scarce verifiable compute instead of free signups, cluster rewards are paid once, not per address. An identity earns only when its quartz recurs, its vertex survives audit, and a ripple from an unlinked peer confirms it.
